cardinality.rule: Events.VOLUME_VIEWPORT_SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS fires for a stack, a volume in any orientation and a video, from utilities.scroll and from viewport.scroll, on the element and on eventTarget, and not with loop; the detail is { viewportId, renderingEngineId, displaySetId, volumeId, sliceIndex, numberOfSlices, delta, direction, imageId }, and sliceIndex is the position the scroll stopped at: detail.currentImageId is detail.imageId, numScrollSteps is numberOfSlices - 1, and currentStepIndex, desiredStepIndex and viewport have no key (getEnabledElementByIds(viewportId, renderingEngineId).viewport)

Events.STACK_SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS fires for a stack, a volume in any orientation and a video, from utilities.scroll and from viewport.scroll, on the element and on eventTarget, and not with loop; the detail is { viewportId, renderingEngineId, displaySetId, volumeId, sliceIndex, numberOfSlices, delta, direction, imageId }, and sliceIndex is the position the scroll stopped at: detail.direction is detail.delta, and detail.imageIdIndex (the position before the scroll) has no key

Events.STACK_SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: SCROLL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS fires for a stack, a volume in any orientation and a video, from utilities.scroll and from viewport.scroll, on the element and on eventTarget, and not with loop; the detail is { viewportId, renderingEngineId, displaySetId, volumeId, sliceIndex, numberOfSlices, delta, direction, imageId }, and sliceIndex is the position the scroll stopped at: detail.direction is detail.delta, and detail.imageIdIndex (the position before the scroll) has no key
